I'm working on the Backstage search backend plugin and need to add a new action to the backend actions registry that lets agents query the search engine.

*   The createQueryAction function must accept an object with engine, actionsRegistry, searchIndexService, and logger properties, and register a search query action with the actionsRegistry without throwing, even when searchIndexService.getDocumentTypes() returns an empty object.

*   The registered action must accept input with a required term (string) field and optional types (string array), filters (nested object), pageLimit (number), and pageCursor (string) fields, and forward all of these fields as-is to the engine's query method.

*   The registered action's output must include a results array, an optional nextPageCursor string, an optional totalItems number (mapped from numberOfResults in the engine response), and a hasMoreResults boolean.

*   hasMoreResults must be true when the engine response contains a nextPageCursor, and false when nextPageCursor is absent.

*   The authorization field must be stripped from every result document before it is included in the output results array.

*   Results whose document location uses a protocol other than http: or https: (such as javascript: or data:) must be excluded from the output results. For each excluded result, logger.info must be called with a message that contains the unsafe URL (e.g. a string containing 'javascript:' or 'data:').


*   Interface details: Type: Function
Name: createQueryAction
Location: plugins/search-backend/src/actions/createQueryAction.ts
Signature: createQueryAction({ engine, actionsRegistry, searchIndexService, logger }: { engine: SearchEngine; actionsRegistry: ActionsRegistryService; searchIndexService: SearchIndexService; logger: LoggerService; }): void
Description: Registers a search query action with the provided actions registry. The action accepts { term: string, types?: string[], filters?: JsonObject, pageLimit?: number, pageCursor?: string } as input and returns { results: Array<{ type: string, document: { title: string, text: string, location: string, [key: string]: any } }>, nextPageCursor?: string, totalItems?: number, hasMoreResults: boolean } as output. Authorization fields are stripped from documents, results with unsafe location protocols are filtered out (logging each exclusion via logger.info with a message containing the protocol), and all input fields are forwarded to engine.query.


**CRITICAL:** Do not modify any files in the `tests/` directory.
The verification system will apply test patches automatically.
Your task is to implement the feature in source files only.

36	Query entities from the Backstage Software Catalog using predicate filters.
37	
38	## Catalog Model
39	
40	The catalog contains entities of different kinds. Every entity has "kind", "apiVersion", "metadata", and optionally "spec" and "relations". Fields use dot notation for querying.
41	
42	Common metadata fields on all entities: name, namespace (default: "default"), title, description, labels, annotations, tags (string array), links.
43	
44	Entity references use the format "kind:namespace/name", e.g. "component:default/my-service" or "user:default/jane.doe".
45	
46	### Entity Kinds
47	
48	**Component** - A piece of software such as a service, website, or library.
49	  spec fields: type (e.g. "service", "website", "library"), lifecycle (e.g. "production", "experimental", "deprecated"), owner (entity ref), system, subcomponentOf, providesApis, consumesApis, dependsOn, dependencyOf.
50	
51	**API** - An interface that components expose, such as REST APIs or event streams.
52	  spec fields: type (e.g. "openapi", "asyncapi", "graphql", "grpc"), lifecycle, owner (entity ref), definition (the API spec content), system.
53	
54	**System** - A collection of components, APIs, and resources that together expose some functionality.
55	  spec fields: owner (entity ref), domain, type.
56	
57	**Domain** - A grouping of systems that share terminology, domain models, and business purpose.
58	  spec fields: owner (entity ref), subdomainOf, type.
59	
60	**Resource** - Infrastructure required to operate a component, such as databases or storage buckets.
61	  spec fields: type, owner (entity ref), system, dependsOn, dependencyOf.
62	
63	**Group** - An organizational entity such as a team or business unit.
64	  spec fields: type (e.g. "team", "business-unit"), children (entity refs), parent (entity ref), members (entity refs), profile (displayName, email, picture).
65	
66	**User** - A person, such as an employee or contractor.
67	  spec fields: memberOf (entity refs), profile (displayName, email, picture).
68	
69	**Location** - A marker that references other catalog descriptor files to be ingested.
70	  spec fields: type, target, targets, presence.
71	
72	### Relations
73	
74	Entities have bidirectional relations stored in the "relations" array. Common relation types: ownedBy/ownerOf, dependsOn/dependencyOf, providesApi/apiProvidedBy, consumesApi/apiConsumedBy, parentOf/childOf, memberOf/hasMember, partOf/hasPart.
75	
76	Relations can be queried via "relations.<type>" e.g. "relations.ownedby: user:default/jane-doe". The value there must always be a valid entity reference.
77	
78	When querying for entity relationships, prefer using relations over spec fields. For example, use "relations.ownedby" instead of "spec.owner" to find entities owned by a particular group or user.
79	
80	## Query Syntax
81	
82	The query uses predicate expressions with dot-notation field paths.
83	
84	Simple matching:
85	  { query: { kind: "Component" } }
86	  { query: { kind: "Component", "spec.type": "service" } }
87	
88	Value operators:
89	  { query: { kind: { "$in": ["API", "Component"] } } }
90	  { query: { "metadata.annotations.backstage.io/techdocs-ref": { "$exists": true } } }
91	  { query: { "metadata.tags": { "$contains": "java" } } }
92	  { query: { "metadata.name": { "$hasPrefix": "team-" } } }
93	
94	Logical operators:
95	  { query: { "$all": [{ kind: "Component" }, { "spec.lifecycle": "production" }] } }
96	  { query: { "$any": [{ "spec.type": "service" }, { "spec.type": "website" }] } }
97	  { query: { "$not": { kind: "Group" } } }
98	
99	Querying relations - find all entities owned by a specific group:
100	  { query: { "relations.ownedby": "group:default/team-alpha" } }
101	
102	Combined example - find production services or websites with TechDocs:
103	  { query: { "$all": [
104	    { kind: "Component", "spec.lifecycle": "production" },
105	    { "$any": [{ "spec.type": "service" }, { "spec.type": "website" }] },
106	    { "metadata.annotations.backstage.io/techdocs-ref": { "$exists": true } }
107	  ] } }
108	
109	## Other Options
110	
111	Limit returned fields: { fields: ["kind", "metadata.name", "metadata.namespace"] }
112	Sort results: { orderFields: { field: "metadata.name", order: "asc" } }
113	Full text search: { fullTextFilter: { term: "auth", fields: ["metadata.name", "metadata.title"] } }

## Summary

I implemented the `createQueryAction` function and wired it into the search backend plugin.

**New file — `plugins/search-backend/src/actions/createQueryAction.ts`:**
- Accepts `{ engine, actionsRegistry, searchIndexService, logger }` and registers a `search-query` action. It calls `searchIndexService.getDocumentTypes()` to enrich the description, guarding against an empty result so it never throws.
- **Input schema:** required `term` (string), optional `types` (string[]), `filters` (nested passthrough object), `pageLimit` (number), `pageCursor` (string). All are forwarded to `engine.query`.
- **Output schema:** `results` array, optional `nextPageCursor`, optional `totalItems` (mapped from the engine's `numberOfResults`), and `hasMoreResults` (`!!nextPageCursor`).
- **Security handling** (mirrors the existing `router.ts` logic): each result document has its `authorization` field stripped, and results whose `location` uses a protocol other than `http:`/`https:` are excluded — logging each exclusion via `logger.info` with a message containing the unsafe protocol (e.g. `javascript:`, `data:`).

**Supporting changes:**
- `plugins/search-backend/src/actions/index.ts` — a `createSearchActions` aggregator following the notifications-backend convention.
- `plugins/search-backend/src/plugin.ts` — added the `actionsRegistryServiceRef` dependency and a `createSearchActions(...)` call during init so the action is actually registered at runtime.

Verification: `yarn tsc` passes with no errors, and `eslint` reports no issues on the changed files. (The `yarn lint` wrapper failed only because it tries to diff against a nonexistent `origin/master` in this environment — unrelated to the code.) I did not touch anything under `tests/`.
